definitions.explanation: Not following the normal or expected pattern. Used especially for unsettled weather and for irregular bodily cycles.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{天候|てんこう}→天候：03558_tenkou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{不順|ふじゅん}だ。
examples.english: The weather is unsettled this year.

examples.japanese: {不順|ふじゅん}な⟦{気候|きこう}→気候：00231_kikou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{不規則|ふきそく}→不規則：15651_fukisoku⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{体調|たいちょう}→体調：04644_taichou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{不順|ふじゅん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧やすい。
examples.english: When your lifestyle is irregular, your physical condition easily becomes unstable.

notes:
Composed of {不|ふ} (not) plus ⟦{順|じゅん}→順：03342_jun⟧ (orderly, smooth). Describes something that departs from its normal, regular pattern.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {天候不順|てんこうふじゅん}: unsettled weather
- {生理不順|せいりふじゅん}: irregular menstruation
- {不順|ふじゅん}な⟦{気候|きこう}→気候：00231_kikou⟧: irregular climate

COMMON PATTERNS:
Used as a na-adjective ({不順|ふじゅん}な⟦{天気|てんき}→天気：00582_tenki⟧) and very often as the second half of compound nouns like {天候不順|てんこうふじゅん}.
